title: Cortical Layers, Parcellations & Cell-Type Atlas
purpose: Prevent 'frontal lobe' and even named cortical areas from becoming terminal explanations by exposing laminae, projection classes, inhibitory classes, glia, molecular identity and competing parcellation systems.

laminar_frame.name: Molecular layer
features: sparse neurons relative to deeper layers

laminar_frame.name: Internal granular
features: prominent thalamocortical input in primary sensory cortex

laminar_frame.name: Multiform
features: feedback to thalamus and other targets

laminar_frame.name: Layer 6b / subplate-related populations
laminar_frame.boundary: Adult 6b is not simply embryonic subplate unchanged.

major_cell_families.organization: strong laminar and area-specific projection classes
multiple developmental/molecular classes distributed across layers
major_cell_families.boundary: Marker families contain many finer types.

major_cell_families.organization: astrocytes, oligodendrocytes, OPCs, microglia, vascular and other cells vary across region/state

parcellation_lenses.name: Brodmann/cytoarchitecture
parcellation_lenses.limit: boundaries/functional interpretations are not complete modern network maps

parcellation_lenses.name: multimodal MRI parcellations
parcellation_lenses.strength: combine myelin, connectivity, function and architecture in vivo

parcellation_lenses.name: transcriptomic/cell-type atlases
parcellation_lenses.strength: resolve molecular populations and spatial arrangements
parcellation_lenses.limit: sampling, donor, tissue-quality and taxonomy integration remain active challenges

human_spatial_atlas.finding: Recent single-cell/spatial transcriptomic work sampled multiple adult human cortical regions and mapped large numbers of nuclei/cells with region- and layer-specific expression patterns.
human_spatial_atlas.consequence: A cortical 'Room' should expose its laminar/cell-type composition and long-range projection class rather than being treated as one homogeneous unit.

thalamocortical_loop.feedforward: Specific thalamic systems preferentially target particular cortical layers/areas, often prominently layer IV in primary sensory cortex.
thalamocortical_loop.feedback: Corticothalamic neurons, especially layer VI classes, send extensive feedback to thalamus/TRN.
thalamocortical_loop.project_use: House↔Rooms becomes scientifically more accurate as a recurrent bidirectional loop rather than one-way relay.

truth_rules: No cortical area has one universal function independent of network/task/state.
Cell-type taxonomies are hierarchical and evolving; named molecular types are not immutable Platonic categories.
Human cell atlases reduce reliance on rodent extrapolation but still depend on donor sampling and post-mortem/spatial methodology.
Cytoarchitecture, transcriptomics, connectivity and functional parcellation are complementary coordinate systems, not one final map.
